transcript.text: Back in 2025 I was telling a coworker about that quick sightseeing day in Xi'an—honestly the food and the old city vibe were the best part.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that same year I’d been chatting about a train run from Beijing to Shanghai—someone else handled the details, I just showed up and followed along.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Shanghai itself was a whole thing too—when we talked hotels, it was all about staying in Shanghai proper so we could walk around at night.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Xi'an day, Cao Yun had already gotten tickets for the Bell Tower, set for 2025-03-20.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember it was the afternoon slot, and it was for 3 people—felt like the perfect time because the light was nicer by then.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That Beijing-to-Shanghai ride was on train G1 on 2025-03-02, and the ticket was under Zhang Wei.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He’d picked Second Class, and separately my friend Sophia Garcia had stayed at the Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund—checked in 2025-05-27 for 5 nights, which sounded wildly fancy.
